fixture_policy: Screenshots are UI/rule fixtures, not complete-night victories. Only /tmp save paths are used. Visible buttons use synthetic mouse input; setup may inject rewards, phase, injury ratios or invalid saves. Complete-night proof is in the main P5 suite.

results.check: Reward target selector applies only selected Iron Shoulder
Market target selector equips selected Vermilion and debits visible price
Boss phase panel reads current actual profile phase by simulation time
Managed battle hides standalone rematch ending
Real save-and-exit presents intro after successful save
Real new-night button can replace saved active night with attacker seat
New-night button preserves discoveries from a valid failed-night save
Discovery merge carries no resources, build modifiers, combat stats or battle history
Corrupt save cannot dispose or replace an existing live night and battle
Failed corrupt-load never overwrites the source save
Rejected snapshot restore leaves the old live battle, night and clock intact
Snapshot failure is explicit and does not overwrite the saved file
Validated snapshot replaces the prior battle only after successful restore
Real mutation reward transforms the selected white once, preserving uid and injury ratio without a hidden incense charge
Mutation pickers list only legal unmutated white ghosts and exclude the previous elite
Real market mutation purchase charges its visible 15 incense price and disables the purchased card
